verdict.overall: ACCEPT WITH CONDITIONS the low inlet ROUTING (block on the case OD at the head plug); REJECT the internal flow path as drawn
reject_reasons: single 3 mm passage: 49.5 m/s at 0.26 kg/s, 25 C; inlet path 16.8-18.7 bar (4-5 mm case hole, aligned; 11.0 bar from the passage friction + exit alone; 27.6 bar if 180 deg out of clock) vs 2.70 bar for the WHOLE line
manifold 18.2-20.1 bar below Psat at 25 C: equilibrium flash quality 0.21-0.23 (void 68-72 %) upstream of the metering seat; 100 % lift (Dyer, optimistic) 2.24-3.34 mm vs 1.74-2.11 mm (v3.3 path)

single jet on the needle body: 12.2 N at 0.26 kg/s (9.3 N at 100 %), 76 mm below the guide -> ~55 N guide friction (ESTIMATE, mu 0.2); feed head / injector dP 37 % -> first-harmonic flux asymmetry up to 19 %
low entry leaves 4.1 cm3 of the 10 mm bore as a dead leg above it (v3.3 0.8 cm3); head wall in flight 311-747 K > T_crit 309.5 K -> vapour pocket; bleed cannot vent it (priming dead end)
conditions: C1 every flow section >= 35 mm2 (<= 10 m/s at 0.26 kg/s, 25 C); inlet path <= v3.3 (1.28 bar at 0.26 kg/s, 15 C), target <= 1.0 bar; line total at 15 C <= 2.70 bar (v3.3 2.51, example E1 2.49, E2 2.01)
C2 flow-through manifold: entry at the TOP of the bore (v3.3 hydraulics, example E1) or <= 0.8 cm3 above a low entry (filler sleeve)
C3 a low entry needs >= 4 equal feeds (example E2: net lateral jet 0.14 N, flux bound 0.23 %) and an annulus >= 17.5 mm2; a single path needs the case hole clocked to the passage (pin)
C4 no single seal between the N2O annulus and chamber gas: two seals + an overboard-vented interspace (reject the +3 mm variant)
C5 the <= 15 um / Cv >= 2.2 filter (OI-7) goes downstream of the hose and the riser weld (bonnet screen seat deleted)
C6 relief <= 7.5 MPa covers the valve->seat volume (liquid-full: relief after 4.5-5.6 K of warming); block isolated from the case, riser shielded (Mechanical G5)

C7 relight with a vapour-filled line: purge at the 12.5 % ignition lift 0.31 s (valve at the coil end) / 0.48 s (valve at the zone top) vs the 0.23 s window (v2 basis 0.25 s, pre-existing) -> sequence owners add a pre-purge or a T-gated check
unchanged: ENG-05 tail-off and dribble: all added volume is upstream of the metering seat (shutdown: pintle first, valve after seating)
priming rule kept for a flow-through manifold: isentropic bound volume-independent; bleed vents 63 cm3/s N2 whatever the volume
